message.content:
I'm going to have to delay the postmortem. The ORM exporter is much faster and would provide the necessary data in time. I'll let the postmortem team know to use the ORM exporter instead.

Submit_report: The failed-jobs backlog has been cleared, and the failed_jobs table has been exported using the ORM exporter. The postmortem team has been informed to use this export instead of waiting for the pg_dump export. Next step: conduct the postmortem and identify the root cause of the job failures.
